rationale: The setup is ambiguous: the stock gapped down ~21% and has clawed back nearly all of that gap, sitting at 91.6% of today's range near the intraday high of $12.45, yet the most recent candles show a stalling/slight distribution pattern with declining volume and price drifting lower from the high. The 5-min ATR of $0.04 appears anomalously small relative to the actual candle ranges observed, undermining reliable stop placement. With no news catalyst identified, a wide 57-bps spread, and no historical comparable setups to anchor expectation, the risk/reward on either side lacks sufficient mechanical clarity to justify an entry.
